payload.title: Cooling with Outdoor Air
payload.full_text: 1) Except for HVAC systems serving only dwelling units or hotel or motel rooms, each system that incorporates mechanical cooling and has an air-handling capacity of more than 1 500 L/s or a cooling capacity of more than 20 kW shall be designed to use outdoor air to reduce mechanical cooling energy by one of the means covered in Articles 5.2.2.8. and 5.2.2.9.
